+"""Business days (Monday to Friday) for dated transfers. Public holidays are not counted."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from datetime import date, timedelta
+
+SATURDAY = 5
+
+
+def next_business_day(d: date) -> date:
+    """``d`` itself from Monday to Friday, otherwise the next Monday."""
+    if d.weekday() >= SATURDAY:
+        return d + timedelta(days=7 - d.weekday())
+    return d
+
+
+def add_business_days(d: date, n: int) -> date:
+    """The date ``n`` business days after ``next_business_day(d)``."""
+    if n < 0:
+        raise ValueError("n must not be negative")
+    day = next_business_day(d)
+    for _ in range(n):
+        day = next_business_day(day + timedelta(days=1))
+    return day

+from datetime import date
+
+import pytest
+
+from bank.business_days import add_business_days, next_business_day
+
+
+def test_saturday_moves_to_monday():
+    assert next_business_day(date(2026, 11, 14)) == date(2026, 11, 16)
+
+
+def test_sunday_moves_to_monday():
+    assert next_business_day(date(2026, 11, 15)) == date(2026, 11, 16)
+
+
+def test_friday_is_a_business_day():
+    assert next_business_day(date(2026, 11, 13)) == date(2026, 11, 13)
+
+
+def test_add_business_days_skips_the_weekend():
+    assert add_business_days(date(2026, 11, 13), 1) == date(2026, 11, 16)
+    assert add_business_days(date(2026, 11, 11), 5) == date(2026, 11, 18)
+
+
+def test_negative_business_days_are_refused():
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        add_business_days(date(2026, 11, 13), -1)
